articles.title: Live coverage: SpaceX to launch a Falcon 9 rocket on St. Patrick’s Day morning
articles.summary: The Starlink 10-46 mission will add another 29 Starlink V2 Mini satellites to the low Earth orbit constellation. Liftoff from pad 40 at Cape Canaveral Space Force Station is scheduled during a window that opens at 6:26 a.m. EDT (1026 UTC).

articles.title: Kayrros sale signals rising demand for satellite intelligence amid Hormuz crisis
articles.summary:
Tensions around the Strait of Hormuz have pushed interest in commercial geospatial intelligence services to unprecedented levels, an executive at Kayrros said after the satellite analytics provider agreed to be acquired by Energy Aspects.

articles.title: NASA Invites Media to Learn About Upcoming X-59 Test Flights
articles.summary: NASA will hold a media teleconference at 5:30 p.m. EDT on Thursday, March 19 to highlight plans for its X-59 quiet supersonic aircraft’s upcoming flight tests.
